name: @shareyou/i18n
description: Type-safe translations powered by Shareyou templater, locale fallback and generated contracts

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm run check:messages && tsc -p tsconfig.typecheck.json
scripts.generate:types: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js generate --source examples/locales/en.json --locale zh-CN=examples/locales/zh-CN.json --out examples/i18n.generated.d.ts
scripts.check:messages: node dist/cli.js generate --source examples/locales/en.json --locale zh-CN=examples/locales/zh-CN.json --out examples/i18n.generated.d.ts --check
